description: Create a folder or nested subfolder after checking list_folders. Pass parent to nest it; omit team for a private root, and pass a team slug only when sharing was requested. A subfolder inherits its parent's space. The answer's `space` says where it landed: report that to the person.

parent.description: Parent folder id for a nested subfolder; omit for a top-level folder

team.description: Team slug; omit for a private folder

title.description: Name of the project or body of work

name: create_folder
title: Create project folder
